## 🪲 Bug Report

**Before submitting**, please search the [open issues](https://github.com/fares-moustafa/Codey-Community/issues) to verify if this bug has already been reported.

---

### 📝 Summary
A clear and concise description of the bug.

### 👣 Steps to Reproduce
1. Go to '...'
2. Run command '...'
3. See error '...'

### 🎯 Expected Behavior
What you expected to happen.

### ⚠️ Actual Behavior
What actually happened (include any console logs, crash traces, or error messages).

### 💻 Environment Details
* **OS**: macOS / Windows / Linux (specify version)
* **Codey Version**: Run `codey --version` to check (e.g. `v3.5.1`)
* **Terminal/Shell**: (e.g., bash, zsh, powershell, git-bash)

### 🖼️ Attachments
Add any screenshots or video recordings showing the bug in action.
